_doc: Per-component difficulty priors. The orchestrator matches each block's id/role against 'match' substrings and applies the entry: hard blocks build MINIMAL, cap fixes at maxFixAttempts, and blocker-fast — NEVER let a builder grind or wedge on a known-hard block. This is the primary defense against the run getting stuck at the same place every time.

components.note: Was HARD under styled Velt (heavy default styling to fight). On the UNSTYLED base (now standard run policy) the default-styling fight is gone, so build it FULLY (buildMinimal:false) and iterate fixes until clean or plateau (--budget governs). Keep hardBudgetMinutes as the firm wedge guard — this family wedged a builder in every early run; reliability risk is separate from difficulty. Revert difficulty→'hard' + buildMinimal→true if it wedges again.

Composer states are achievable clean but carry the send-button opacity gotcha (see sdk-gotchas composer-send-opacity, applied automatically by first-shot-css) and sub-pixel residuals that are R29-acceptable. Don't chase sub-pixel glyph noise.
Sidebar header / panel-tabs typically measures clean quickly (0.16% diff observed). Low risk.

Flows compose already-built states (build LAST). Their full-surface captures are sensitive to seeded-comment DEBRIS — measure against a CLEAN, run-unique documentId, or they falsely GAP on stray comments.
